v.t: The command of God has come, so do not rush it. Glory be to Him; exalted above what they associate
v.l: Ata 'Amru Allahi Fala Tasta`jiluhu Subhanahu Wa Ta`ala `Amma Yushrikuna

v.t: He sends down the angels with the Spirit by His command, upon whom He wills of His servants: “Give warning that there is no god but Me, and fear Me.”
v.l: Yunazzilu Al-Mala'ikata Bir-Ruhi Min 'Amrihi `Ala Man Yasha'u Min `Ibadihi 'An 'Andhiru 'Annahu La 'Ilaha 'Illa 'Ana Fa Attaquni

v.t: He created the heavens and the earth with justice. He is exalted above the associations they attribute
v.l: Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Bil-Haqqi Ta`ala `Amma Yushrikuna

v.t: He created the human being from a drop of fluid, yet he becomes an open adversary
v.l: Khalaqa Al-'Insana Min Nutfatin Fa'idha Huwa Khasimun Mubinun

v.t: And the livestock—He created them for you. In them are warmth and benefits for you, and of them you eat
v.l: Wa Al-'An`ama Khalaqaha Lakum Fiha Dif'un Wa Manafi`u Wa Minha Ta'kuluna

v.t: And there is beauty in them for you, when you bring them home, and when you drive them to pasture
v.l: Wa Lakum Fiha Jamalun Hina Turihuna Wa Hina Tasrahuna

v.t: And they carry your loads to territory you could not have reached without great hardship. Your Lord is Clement and Merciful
v.l: Wa Tahmilu 'Athqalakum 'Ila Baladin Lam Takunu Balighihi 'Illa Bishiqqi Al-'Anfusi 'Inna Rabbakum Lara'ufun Rahimun

v.t: And the horses, and the mules, and the donkeys—for you to ride, and for luxury. And He creates what you do not know
v.l: Wa Al-Khayla Wa Al-Bighala Wa Al-Hamira Litarkabuha Wa Zinatan Wa Yakhluqu Ma La Ta`lamuna

v.t: It is for God to point out the paths, but some of them are flawed. Had He willed, He could have guided you all
v.l: Wa `Ala Allahi Qasdu As-Sabili Wa Minha Ja'irun Wa Law Sha'a Lahadakum 'Ajma`ina
w: surely He would have guided you

v.t: It is He Who sends down for you from the sky water. From it is drink, and with it grows vegetation for grazing
v.l: Huwa Al-Ladhi 'Anzala Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Lakum Minhu Sharabun Wa Minhu Shajarun Fihi Tusimuna

v.t: And He produces for you grains with it, and olives, and date-palms, and grapes, and all kinds of fruits. Surely in that is a sign for people who think
v.l: Yunbitu Lakum Bihi Az-Zar`a Wa Az-Zaytuna Wa An-Nakhila Wa Al-'A`naba Wa Min Kulli Ath-Thamarati 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatan Liqawmin Yatafakkaruna

v.t: And He regulated for you the night and the day; and the sun, and the moon, and the stars are disposed by His command. Surely in that are signs for people who ponder
v.l: Wa Sakhkhara Lakumu Al-Layla Wa An-Nahara Wa Ash-Shamsa Wa Al-Qamara Wa An-Nujumu Musakhkharatun Bi'amrihi 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Liqawmin Ya`qiluna

v.t: And whatsoever He created for you on earth is of diverse colors. Surely in that is a sign for people who are mindful
v.l: Wa Ma Dhara'a Lakum Fi Al-'Arđi Mukhtalifaan 'Alwanuhu 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatan Liqawmin Yadhakkaruna

v.t: And it is He who made the sea to serve you, that you may eat from it tender meat, and extract from it ornaments that you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, as you seek His bounties, so that you may give thanks
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Sakhkhara Al-Bahra Lita'kulu Minhu Lahmaan Tariyaan Wa Tastakhriju Minhu Hilyatan Talbasunaha Wa Tara Al-Fulka Mawakhira Fihi Wa Litabtaghu Min Fađlihi Wa La`allakum Tashkuruna

v.t: And he cast mountains on the earth, lest it shifts with you; and rivers, and roads, so that you may be guided
v.l: Wa 'Alqa Fi Al-'Arđi Rawasiya 'An Tamida Bikum Wa 'Anharaan Wa Subulaan Lla`allakum Tahtaduna

v.t: And landmarks. And by the stars they guide themselves
v.l: Wa `Alamatin Wa Bin-Najmi Hum Yahtaduna

v.t: Is He who creates like him who does not create? Will you not take a lesson
v.l: Afaman Yakhluqu Kaman La Yakhluqu 'Afala Tadhakkaruna

v.t: And if you tried to enumerate the favors of God, you will not be able to count them. God is Forgiving and Merciful
v.l: Wa 'In Ta`uddu Ni`mata Allahi La Tuhsuha 'Inna Allaha Laghafurun Rahimun

v.t: And God knows what you hide and what you disclose
v.l: Wa Allahu Ya`lamu Ma Tusirruna Wa Ma Tu`linuna

v.t: Those they invoke besides God create nothing, but are themselves created
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Yad`una Min Duni Allahi La Yakhluquna Shay'aan Wa Hum Yukhlaquna

v.t: They are dead, not alive; and they do not know when they will be resurrected
v.l: Amwatun Ghayru 'Ahya'in Wa Ma Yash`uruna 'Ayyana Yub`athuna

v.t: Your God is one God. As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are in denial, and they are arrogant
v.l: Ilahukum 'Ilahun Wahidun Fa-Al-Ladhina La Yu'uminuna Bil-'Akhirati Qulubuhum Munkiratun Wa Hum Mustakbiruna

v.t: Without a doubt, God knows what they conceal and what they reveal. He does not like the arrogant
v.l: La Jarama 'Anna Allaha Ya`lamu Ma Yusirruna Wa Ma Yu`linuna 'Innahu La Yuhibbu Al-Mustakbirina

v.t: And when it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “Legends of the ancients.”
v.l: Wa 'Idha Qila Lahum Madha 'Anzala Rabbukum Qalu 'Asatiru Al-'Awwalina

v.t: So let them carry their loads complete on the Day of Resurrection, and some of the loads of those they misguided without knowledge. Evil is what they carry
v.l: Liyahmilu 'Awzarahum Kamilatan Yawma Al-Qiyamati Wa Min 'Awzari Al-Ladhina Yuđillunahum Bighayri `Ilmin 'Ala Sa'a Ma Yaziruna

v.t: Those before them also schemed, but God took their structures from the foundations, and the roof caved in on them. The punishment came at them from where they did not perceive
v.l: Qad Makara Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Fa'ata Allahu Bunyanahum Mina Al-Qawa`idi Fakharra `Alayhimu As-Saqfu Min Fawqihim Wa 'Atahumu Al-`Adhabu Min Haythu La Yash`uruna

v.t: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them, and say, “Where are My associates for whose sake you used to dispute?” Those who were given knowledge will say, “Today shame and misery are upon the disbelievers.”
v.l: Thumma Yawma Al-Qiyamati Yukhzihim Wa Yaqulu 'Ayna Shuraka'iya Al-Ladhina Kuntum Tushaqquna Fihim Qala Al-Ladhina 'Utu Al-`Ilma 'Inna Al-Khizya Al-Yawma Wa As-Su'a `Ala Al-Kafirina

v.t: Those wronging their souls while the angels are taking them away—they will propose peace: “We did no wrong.” Yes you did. God is aware of what you used to do.”
v.l: Al-Ladhina Tatawaffahumu Al-Mala'ikatu Zalimi 'Anfusihim Fa'alqaw As-Salama Ma Kunna Na`malu Min Su'in Bala 'Inna Allaha `Alimun Bima Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: Enter the gates of Hell, to dwell therein forever. Miserable is the residence of the arrogant
v.l: Fadkhulu 'Abwaba Jahannama Khalidina Fiha Falabi'sa Mathwa Al-Mutakabbirina

v.t: And it will be said to those who maintained piety, “What has your Lord revealed?” They will say, “Goodness.” To those who do good in this world is goodness, and the Home of the Hereafter is even better. How wonderful is the residence of the pious
v.l: Wa Qila Lilladhina Attaqaw Madha 'Anzala Rabbukum Qalu Khayraan Lilladhina 'Ahsanu Fi Hadhihi Ad-Dunya Hasanatun Wa Ladaru Al-'Akhirati Khayrun Wa Lani`ma Daru Al-Muttaqina

v.t: The Gardens of Perpetuity, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow, where they will have whatever they desire. Thus God rewards the pious
v.l: Jannatu `Adnin Yadkhulunaha Tajri Min Tahtiha Al-'Anharu Lahum Fiha Ma Yasha'una Kadhalika Yajzi Allahu Al-Muttaqina

v.t: Those who are in a wholesome state when the angels take them—will say, “Peace be upon you; enter Paradise, for what you used to do.”
v.l: Al-Ladhina Tatawaffahumu Al-Mala'ikatu Tayyibina Yaquluna Salamun `Alaykumu Adkhulu Al-Jannata Bima Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: Are they but waiting for the angels to come to them, or for the command of your Lord to arrive? Those before them did likewise. God did not wrong them, but they used to wrong their own souls
v.l: Hal Yanzuruna 'Illa 'An Ta'tiyahumu Al-Mala'ikatu 'Aw Ya'tiya 'Amru Rabbika Kadhalika Fa`ala Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Wa Ma Zalamahumu Allahu Wa Lakin Kanu 'Anfusahum Yazlimuna

v.t: So the evils of their deeds assailed them, and what they used to ridicule engulfed them
v.l: Fa'asabahum Sayyi'atu Ma `Amilu Wa Haqa Bihim Ma Kanu Bihi Yastahzi'un

v.t: The idolaters say, “Had God willed, we would not have worshiped anything besides Him, neither us, nor our ancestors, nor would we have prohibited anything besides His prohibitions.” Those before them did likewise. Are the messengers responsible for anything but clear communication
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina 'Ashraku Law Sha'a Allahu Ma `Abadna Min Dunihi Min Shay'in Nahnu Wa La 'Aba'uuna Wa La Harramna Min Dunihi Min Shay'in Kadhalika Fa`ala Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Fahal `Ala Ar-Rusuli 'Illa Al-Balaghu Al-Mubinu

v.t: To every community We sent a messenger: “Worship God, and avoid idolatry.” Some of them God guided, while others deserved misguidance. So travel through the earth, and see what the fate of the deniers was
v.l: Wa Laqad Ba`athna Fi Kulli 'Ummatin Rasulaan 'Ani Au`budu Allaha Wa Ajtanibu At-Taghuta Faminhum Man Hada Allahu Wa Minhum Man Haqqat `Alayhi Ađ-Đalalatu Fasiru Fi Al-'Arđi Fanzuru Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Mukadhibina

v.t: Even though you may be concerned about their guidance, God does not guide those who misguide. And they will have no saviors
v.l: In Tahris `Ala Hudahum Fa'inna Allaha La Yahdi Man Yuđillu Wa Ma Lahum Min Nasirina

v.t: And they swear by God with their most solemn oaths, “God will not resurrect anyone who dies.” Yes indeed, it is a promise binding on Him, but most people do not know
v.l: Wa 'Aqsamu Billahi Jahda 'Aymanihim La Yab`athu Allahu Man Yamutu Bala Wa`daan `Alayhi Haqqaan Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Ya`lamuna

v.t: To clarify for them what they differed about, and for the faithless to know that they were liars
v.l: Liyubayyina Lahumu Al-Ladhi Yakhtalifuna Fihi Wa Liya`lama Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'Annahum Kanu Kadhibina

v.t: When We intend for something to happen, We say to it, “Be,” and it becomes
v.l: Innama Qawluna Lishay'in 'Idha 'Aradnahu 'An Naqula Lahu Kun Fayakunu

v.t: Those who emigrate for God’s sake after being persecuted, We will settle them in a good place in this world; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Hajaru Fi Allahi Min Ba`di Ma Zulimu Lanubawwi'annahum Fi Ad-Dunya Hasanatan Wa La'ajru Al-'Akhirati 'Akbaru Law Kanu Ya`lamuna
w: surely We will give them position

v.t: Those who endure patiently, and in their Lord they put their trust
v.l: Al-Ladhina Sabaru Wa `Ala Rabbihim Yatawakkaluna

v.t: We did not send before you except men whom We inspired. So ask the people of knowledge, if you do not know
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalna Min Qablika 'Illa Rijalaan Nuhi 'Ilayhim Fas'alu 'Ahla Adh-Dhikri 'In Kuntum La Ta`lamuna

v.t: With the clarifications and the scriptures. And We revealed to you the Reminder, that you may clarify to the people what was revealed to them, and that they may reflect
v.l: Bil-Bayyinati Wa Az-Zuburi Wa 'Anzalna 'Ilayka Adh-Dhikra Litubayyina Lilnnasi Ma Nuzzila 'Ilayhim Wa La`allahum Yatafakkaruna

v.t: Do those who scheme evils feel secure that God will not cause the earth to cave in with them, or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive
v.l: Afa'amina Al-Ladhina Makaru As-Sayyi'ati 'An Yakhsifa Allahu Bihimu Al-'Arđa 'Aw Ya'tiyahumu Al-`Adhabu Min Haythu La Yash`uruna

v.t: Or that He will not seize them during their activities? And they will not be able to prevent it
v.l: Aw Ya'khudhahum Fi Taqallubihim Fama Hum Bimu`jizina

v.t: Or that He will not seize them while in dread? Your Lord is Gentle and Merciful
v.l: Aw Ya'khudhahum `Ala Takhawwufin Fa'inna Rabbakum Lara'ufun Rahimun

v.t: Have they not observed what God has created? Their shadows revolve from the right and the left, bowing to God as they shrink away
v.l: Awalam Yaraw 'Ila Ma Khalaqa Allahu Min Shay'in Yatafayya'u Zilaluhu `Ani Al-Yamini Wa Ash-Shama'ili Sujjadaan Lillahi Wa Hum Dakhiruna

v.t: To God bows down everything in the heavens and everything on earth—every living creature, and the angels, and without being proud
v.l: Wa Lillahi Yasjudu Ma Fi As-Samawati Wa Ma Fi Al-'Arđi Min Dabbatin Wa Al-Mala'ikatu Wa Hum La Yastakbiruna

v.t: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded
v.l: Yakhafuna Rabbahum Min Fawqihim Wa Yaf`aluna Ma Yu'umaruna

v.t: God has said: “Do not take two gods; He is only One God; so fear only Me.”
v.l: Wa Qala Allahu La Tattakhidhu 'Ilahayni Athnayni 'Innama Huwa 'Ilahun Wahidun Fa'iyaya Farhabuni

v.t: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; and to Him obedience is due always. Do you, then, fear anyone other than God
v.l: Wa Lahu Ma Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Lahu Ad-Dinu Wa Asibaan 'Afaghayra Allahi Tattaquna

v.t: Whatever blessing you have is from God. And when harm touches you, it is to Him that you groan
v.l: Wa Ma Bikum Min Ni`matin Famina Allahi Thumma 'Idha Massakumu Ađ-Đurru Fa'ilayhi Taj'aruna

v.t: But when He lifts the harm from you, some of you associate others with their Lord
v.l: Thumma 'Idha Kashafa Ađ-Đurra `Ankum 'Idha Fariqun Minkum Birabbihim Yushrikuna

v.t: To show ingratitude for what We have given them. Enjoy yourselves. You will soon know
v.l: Liyakfuru Bima 'Ataynahum Fatamatta`u Fasawfa Ta`lamuna

v.t: And they allocate, to something they do not know, a share of what We have provided for them. By God, you will be questioned about what you have been inventing
v.l: Wa Yaj`aluna Lima La Ya`lamuna Nasibaan Mimma Razaqnahum Ta-Allahi Latus'alunna `Amma Kuntum Taftaruna

v.t: And they attribute to God daughters—exalted is He—and for themselves what they desire
v.l: Wa Yaj`aluna Lillahi Al-Banati Subhanahu Wa Lahum Ma Yashtahuna

v.t: And when one of them is given news of a female infant, his face darkens, and he chokes with grief
v.l: Wa 'Idha Bushira 'Ahaduhum Bil-'Untha Zalla Wajhuhu Muswaddaan Wa Huwa Kazimun

v.t: He hides from the people because of the bad news given to him. Shall he keep it in humiliation, or bury it in the dust? Evil is the decision they make
v.l: Yatawara Mina Al-Qawmi Min Su'i Ma Bushira Bihi 'Ayumsikuhu `Ala Hunin 'Am Yadussuhu Fi At-Turabi 'Ala Sa'a Ma Yahkumuna
w: he has been given good news

v.t: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter set a bad example, while God sets the Highest Example. He is the Mighty, the Wise
v.l: Lilladhina La Yu'uminuna Bil-'Akhirati Mathalu As-Saw'i Wa Lillahi Al-Mathalu Al-'A`la Wa Huwa Al-`Azizu Al-Hakimu

v.t: If God were to hold mankind for their injustices, He would not leave upon it a single creature, but He postpones them until an appointed time. Then, when their time arrives, they will not delay it by one hour, nor will they advance it
v.l: Wa Law Yu'uakhidhu Allahu An-Nasa Bizulmihim Ma Taraka `Alayha Min Dabbatin Wa Lakin Yu'uakhkhiruhum 'Ila 'Ajalin Musammaan Fa'idha Ja'a 'Ajaluhum La Yasta'khiruna Sa`atan Wa La Yastaqdimuna

v.t: And they attribute to God what they themselves dislike, while their tongues utter the lie that theirs is the goodness. Without a doubt, for them is the Fire, and they will be neglected
v.l: Wa Yaj`aluna Lillahi Ma Yakrahuna Wa Tasifu 'Alsinatuhumu Al-Kadhiba 'Anna Lahumu Al-Husna La Jarama 'Anna Lahumu An-Nara Wa 'Annahum Mufratuna

v.t: By God, We sent messengers to communities before you, but Satan made their deeds appear alluring to them. He is their master today, and they will have a painful punishment
v.l: Ta-Allahi Laqad 'Arsalna 'Ila 'Umamin Min Qablika Fazayyana Lahumu Ash-Shaytanu 'A`malahum Fahuwa Waliyuhumu Al-Yawma Wa Lahum `Adhabun 'Alimun

v.t: We revealed to you the Scripture only to clarify for them what they differ about, and guidance and mercy for people who believe
v.l: Wa Ma 'Anzalna `Alayka Al-Kitaba 'Illa Litubayyina Lahumu Al-Ladhi Akhtalafu Fihi Wa Hudaan Wa Rahmatan Liqawmin Yu'uminuna

v.t: God sends down water from the sky, with which He revives the earth after its death. In this is a sign for people who listen
v.l: Wa Allahu 'Anzala Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Fa'ahya Bihi Al-'Arđa Ba`da Mawtiha 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatan Liqawmin Yasma`una

v.t: And there is a lesson for you in cattle: We give you a drink from their bellies, from between waste and blood, pure milk, refreshing to the drinkers
v.l: Wa 'Inna Lakum Fi Al-'An`am La`ibratan Nusqikum Mimma Fi Butunihi Min Bayni Farthin Wa Damin Labanaan Khalisaan Sa'ighaan Lilsharibina

v.t: And from the fruits of date-palms and grapevines, you derive sugar and wholesome food. In this is a sign for people who understand
v.l: Wa Min Thamarati An-Nakhili Wa Al-'A`nabi Tattakhidhuna Minhu Sakaraan Wa Rizqaan Hasanaan 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatan Liqawmin Ya`qiluna

v.t: And your Lord inspired the bee: “Set up hives in the mountains, and in the trees, and in what they construct.”
v.l: Wa 'Awha Rabbuka 'Ila An-Nahli 'Ani Attakhidhi Mina Al-Jibali Buyutaan Wa Mina Ash-Shajari Wa Mimma Ya`rishuna

v.t: Then eat of all the fruits, and go along the pathways of your Lord, with precision. From their bellies emerges a fluid of diverse colors, containing healing for the people. Surely in this is a sign for people who reflect
v.l: Thumma Kuli Min Kulli Ath-Thamarati Fasluki Subula Rabbiki Dhululaan Yakhruju Min Butuniha Sharabun Mukhtalifun 'Alwanuhu Fihi Shifa'un Lilnnasi 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatan Liqawmin Yatafakkaruna

v.t: God created you; then He takes you away. Some of you will be brought back to the worst age, so that he will no longer know anything, after having acquired knowledge. God is Omniscient and Omnipotent
v.l: Wa Allahu Khalaqakum Thumma Yatawaffakum Wa Minkum Man Yuraddu 'Ila 'Ardhali Al-`Umuri Likay La Ya`lama Ba`da `Ilmin Shay'aan 'Inna Allaha `Alimun Qadirun

v.t: God has favored some of you over others in livelihood. Those who are favored would not give their properties to their servants, to the extent of making them partners in it. Will they then renounce God’s blessings
v.l: Wa Allahu Fađđala Ba`đakum `Ala Ba`đin Fi Ar-Rizqi Fama Al-Ladhina Fuđđilu Biraddi Rizqihim `Ala Ma Malakat 'Aymanuhum Fahum Fihi Sawa'un 'Afabini`mati Allahi Yajhaduna

v.t: God has given you mates from among yourselves; and has produced for you, from your mates, children and grandchildren; and has provided you with good things. Will they then believe in falsehood, and refuse God’s favors
v.l: Wa Allahu Ja`ala Lakum Min 'Anfusikum 'Azwajaan Wa Ja`ala Lakum Min 'Azwajikum Banina Wa Hafadatan Wa Razaqakum Mina At-Tayyibati 'Afabialbatili Yu'uminuna Wa Bini`mati Allahi Hum Yakfuruna

v.t: And yet they serve besides God what possesses no provisions for them in the heavens, nor on earth, nor are they capable
v.l: Wa Ya`buduna Min Duni Allahi Ma La Yamliku Lahum Rizqaan Mina As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Shay'aan Wa La Yastati`una

v.t: So do not cite the examples for God. God knows, and you do not know
v.l: Fala Tađribu Lillahi Al-'Amthala 'Inna Allaha Ya`lamu Wa 'Antum La Ta`lamuna

v.t: God cites the example of a bonded slave, who has no power over anything; and someone to whom We have given plentiful provision, from which he gives secretly and openly. Are they equal in comparison? All praise belongs to God, but most of them do not know
v.l: Đaraba Allahu Mathalaan `Abdaan Mamlukaan La Yaqdiru `Ala Shay'in Wa Man Razaqnahu Minna Rizqaan Hasanaan Fahuwa Yunfiqu Minhu Sirraan Wa Jahraan Hal Yastawuna Al-Hamdu Lillahi Bal 'Aktharuhum La Ya`lamuna

v.t: And God cites the example of two men: one of them dumb, unable to do anything, and is a burden on his master; whichever way he directs him, he achieves nothing good. Is he equal to him who commands justice, and is on a straight path
v.l: Wa Đaraba Allahu Mathalaan Rajulayni 'Ahaduhuma 'Abkamu La Yaqdiru `Ala Shay'in Wa Huwa Kallun `Ala Mawlahu 'Aynama Yuwajjhhhu La Ya'ti Bikhayrin Hal Yastawi Huwa Wa Man Ya'muru Bil-`Adli Wa Huwa `Ala Siratin Mustaqimin

v.t: To God belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth. The coming of the Hour is only as the twinkling of the eye, or even nearer. God has power over everything
v.l: Wa Lillahi Ghaybu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Ma 'Amru As-Sa`ati 'Illa Kalamhi Al-Basari 'Aw Huwa 'Aqrabu 'Inna Allaha `Ala Kulli Shay'in Qadirun

v.t: God brought you out of your mothers’ wombs, not knowing anything; and He gave you the hearing, and the eyesight, and the brains; that you may give thanks
v.l: Wa Allahu 'Akhrajakum Min Butuni 'Ummahatikum La Ta`lamuna Shay'aan Wa Ja`ala Lakumu As-Sam`a Wa Al-'Absara Wa Al-'Af'idata La`allakum Tashkuruna

v.t: Have they not seen the birds, flying in the midst of the sky? None sustains them except God. In this are signs for people who believe
v.l: Alam Yaraw 'Ila At-Tayri Musakhkharatin Fi Jawwi As-Sama'i Ma Yumsikuhunna 'Illa Allahu 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Liqawmin Yu'uminuna

v.t: And God has given you in your homes habitats for you, and has provided for you out of the hides of livestock portable homes for you, so you can use them when you travel, and when you camp; and from their wool, and fur, and hair, furnishings and comfort for a while
v.l: Wa Allahu Ja`ala Lakum Min Buyutikum Sakanaan Wa Ja`ala Lakum Min Juludi Al-'An`ami Buyutaan Tastakhiffunaha Yawma Za`nikum Wa Yawma 'Iqamatikum Wa Min 'Aswafiha Wa 'Awbariha Wa 'Ash`ariha 'Athathaan Wa Mata`aan 'Ila Hinin

v.t: And God has made for you shade out of what He has created, and has given you resorts in the mountains, and has given you garments to protect you from the heat, and garments to protect you from your violence. Thus He completes His blessings upon you, so that you may submit
v.l: Wa Allahu Ja`ala Lakum Mimma Khalaqa Zilalaan Wa Ja`ala Lakum Mina Al-Jibali 'Aknanaan Wa Ja`ala Lakum Sarabila Taqikumu Al-Harra Wa Sarabila Taqikum Ba'sakum Kadhalika Yutimmu Ni`matahu `Alaykum La`allakum Tuslimuna

v.t: But if they turn away, your only duty is clear communication
v.l: Fa'in Tawallaw Fa'innama `Alayka Al-Balaghu Al-Mubinu

v.t: They recognize God’s blessing, but then deny it, as most of them are ungrateful
v.l: Ya`rifuna Ni`mata Allahi Thumma Yunkirunaha Wa 'Aktharuhumu Al-Kafiruna

v.t: On the Day when We raise up a witness from every community—those who disbelieved will not be permitted, nor will they be excused
v.l: Wa Yawma Nab`athu Min Kulli 'Ummatin Shahidaan Thumma La Yu'udhanu Lilladhina Kafaru Wa La Hum Yusta`tabuna
w: will be asked to make amends

v.t: When those who did wrong see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved
v.l: Wa 'Idha Ra'a Al-Ladhina Zalamu Al-`Adhaba Fala Yukhaffafu `Anhum Wa La Hum Yunzaruna

v.t: And when the idolaters see their associates, they will say, “Our Lord, these are our associates whom we used to invoke besides You.” They will strike back at them with the saying, “Surely you are liars.”
v.l: Wa 'Idha Ra'a Al-Ladhina 'Ashraku Shuraka'ahum Qalu Rabbana Ha'uula' Shuraka'uuna Al-Ladhina Kunna Nad`u Min Dunika Fa'alqaw 'Ilayhimu Al-Qawla 'Innakum Lakadhibuna

v.t: On that Day they will offer their submission to God, and what they had invented will abandon them
v.l: Wa 'Alqaw 'Ila Allahi Yawma'idhin As-Salama Wa Đalla `Anhum Ma Kanu Yaftaruna

v.t: Those who disbelieve and obstruct from God’s path—We will add punishment to their punishment, on account of the mischief they used to make
v.l: Al-Ladhina Kafaru Wa Saddu `An Sabili Allahi Zidnahum `Adhabaan Fawqa Al-`Adhabi Bima Kanu Yufsiduna

v.t: On the Day when We raise in every community a witness against them, from among them, and bring you as a witness against these. We have revealed to you the Book, as an explanation of all things, and guidance, and mercy and good news for those who submit
v.l: Wa Yawma Nab`athu Fi Kulli 'Ummatin Shahidaan `Alayhim Min 'Anfusihim Wa Ji'na Bika Shahidaan `Ala Ha'uula' Wa Nazzalna `Alayka Al-Kitaba Tibyanaan Likulli Shay'in Wa Hudaan Wa Rahmatan Wa Bushra Lilmuslimina

v.t: God commands justice, and goodness, and generosity towards relatives. And He forbids immorality, and injustice, and oppression. He advises you, so that you may take heed
v.l: Inna Allaha Ya'muru Bil-`Adli Wa Al-'Ihsani Wa 'Ita'i Dhi Al-Qurba Wa Yanha `Ani Al-Fahsha'i Wa Al-Munkari Wa Al-Baghyi Ya`izukum La`allakum Tadhakkaruna

v.t: Fulfill God’s covenant when you make a covenant, and do not break your oaths after ratifying them. You have made God your guarantor, and God knows what you do
v.l: Wa 'Awfu Bi`ahdi Allahi 'Idha `Ahadtum Wa La Tanquđu Al-'Aymana Ba`da Tawkidiha Wa Qad Ja`altumu Allaha `Alaykum Kafilaan 'Inna Allaha Ya`lamu Ma Taf`aluna

v.t: And do not be like her who unravels her yarn, breaking it into pieces, after she has spun it strongly. Nor use your oaths as means of deception among you, because one community is more prosperous than another. God is testing you thereby. On the Day of Resurrection, He will make clear to you everything you had disputed about
v.l: Wa La Takunu Kallati Naqađat Ghazlaha Min Ba`di Quwatin 'Ankathaan Tattakhidhuna 'Aymanakum Dakhalaan Baynakum 'An Takuna 'Ummatun Hiya 'Arba Min 'Ummatin 'Innama Yablukumu Allahu Bihi Wa Layubayyinanna Lakum Yawma Al-Qiyamati Ma Kuntum Fihi Takhtalifuna

v.t: Had God willed, He would have made you one congregation, but He leaves astray whom He wills, and He guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do
v.l: Wa Law Sha'a Allahu Laja`alakum 'Ummatan Wahidatan Wa Lakin Yuđillu Man Yasha'u Wa Yahdi Man Yasha'u Wa Latus'alunna `Amma Kuntum Ta`maluna
w: And surely you will be questioned

v.t: And do not use your oaths to deceive one another, so that a foot may not slip after being firm, and you taste misery because you hindered from God’s path, and incur a terrible torment
v.l: Wa La Tattakhidhu 'Aymanakum Dakhalaan Baynakum Fatazilla Qadamun Ba`da Thubutiha Wa Tadhuqu As-Su'a Bima Sadadtum `An Sabili Allahi Wa Lakum `Adhabun `Azimun

v.t: And do not exchange God’s covenant for a small price. What is with God is better for you, if you only knew
v.l: Wa La Tashtaru Bi`ahdi Allahi Thamanaan Qalilaan 'Innama `Inda Allahi Huwa Khayrun Lakum 'In Kuntum Ta`lamuna

v.t: What you have runs out, but what is with God remains. We will reward those who are patient according to the best of their deeds
v.l: Ma `Indakum Yanfadu Wa Ma `Inda Allahi Baqin Wa Lanajziyanna Al-Ladhina Sabaru 'Ajrahum Bi'ahsani Ma Kanu Ya`maluna

v.t: Whoever works righteousness, whether male or female, while being a believer, We will grant him a good life—and We will reward them according to the best of what they used to do
v.l: Man `Amila Salihaan Min Dhakarin 'Aw 'Untha Wa Huwa Mu'uminun Falanuhyiyannahu Hayaatan Tayyibatan Wa Lanajziyannahum 'Ajrahum Bi'ahsani Ma Kanu Ya`maluna
w: then surely We will give him life

v.t: When you read the Quran, seek refuge with God from Satan the outcast
v.l: Fa'idha Qara'ta Al-Qur'ana Fasta`idh Billahi Mina Ash-Shaytani Ar-Rajimi

v.t: He has no authority over those who believe and trust in their Lord
v.l: Innahu Laysa Lahu Sultanun `Ala Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Ala Rabbihim Yatawakkaluna

v.t: His authority is only over those who follow him, and those who associate others with Him
v.l: Innama Sultanuhu `Ala Al-Ladhina Yatawallawnahu Wa Al-Ladhina Hum Bihi Mushrikuna

v.t: When We substitute a verse in place of another verse—and God knows best what He reveals—they say, “You are an impostor.” But most of them do not know
v.l: Wa 'Idha Baddalna 'Ayatan Makana 'Ayatin Wa Allahu 'A`lamu Bima Yunazzilu Qalu 'Innama 'Anta Muftarin Bal 'Aktharuhum La Ya`lamuna

v.t: Say, “The Holy Spirit has brought it down from your Lord, truthfully, in order to stabilize those who believe, and as guidance and good news for those who submit.”
v.l: Qul Nazzalahu Ruhu Al-Qudusi Min Rabbika Bil-Haqqi Liyuthabbita Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa Hudaan Wa Bushra Lilmuslimina

v.t: We are well aware that they say, “It is a human being who is teaching him.” But the tongue of him they allude to is foreign, while this is a clear Arabic tongue
v.l: Wa Laqad Na`lamu 'Annahum Yaquluna 'Innama Yu`allimuhu Basharun Lisanu Al-Ladhi Yulhiduna 'Ilayhi 'A`jamiyun Wa Hadha Lisanun `Arabiyun Mubinun

v.t: Those who do not believe in God’s revelations—God will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina La Yu'uminuna Bi'ayati Allahi La Yahdihimu Allahu Wa Lahum `Adhabun 'Alimun

v.t: It is those who do not believe in God’s revelations who fabricate falsehood. These are the liars
v.l: Innama Yaftari Al-Kadhiba Al-Ladhina La Yu'uminuna Bi'ayati Allahi Wa 'Ula'ika Humu Al-Kadhibuna

v.t: Whoever renounces faith in God after having believed—except for someone who is compelled, while his heart rests securely in faith—but whoever willingly opens up his heart to disbelief—upon them falls wrath from God, and for them is a tremendous torment
v.l: Man Kafara Billahi Min Ba`di 'Imanihi 'Illa Man 'Ukriha Wa Qalbuhu Mutma'innun Bil-'Imani Wa Lakin Man Sharaha Bil-Kufri Sadraan Fa`alayhim Ghađabun Mina Allahi Wa Lahum `Adhabun `Azimun

v.t: That is because they have preferred the worldly life to the Hereafter, and because God does not guide the people who refuse
v.l: Dhalika Bi'annahumu Astahabbu Al-Hayaata Ad-Dunya `Ala Al-'Akhirati Wa 'Anna Allaha La Yahdi Al-Qawma Al-Kafirina

v.t: It is they whom God has sealed their hearts, and their hearing, and their sight. It is they who are the heedless
v.l: Ula'ika Al-Ladhina Taba`a Allahu `Ala Qulubihim Wa Sam`ihim Wa 'Absarihim Wa 'Ula'ika Humu Al-Ghafiluna

v.t: There is no doubt that in the Hereafter they will be the losers
v.l: La Jarama 'Annahum Fi Al-'Akhirati Humu Al-Khasiruna

v.t: But then your Lord—for those who emigrated after being persecuted, then struggled and persevered—your Lord thereafter is Forgiving and Merciful
v.l: Thumma 'Inna Rabbaka Lilladhina Hajaru Min Ba`di Ma Futinu Thumma Jahadu Wa Sabaru 'Inna Rabbaka Min Ba`diha Laghafurun Rahimun
w: they had been put to trials

v.t: On the Day when every soul will come pleading for itself, and every soul will be paid in full for what it has done, and they will not be wronged
v.l: Yawma Ta'ti Kullu Nafsin Tujadilu `An Nafsiha Wa Tuwaffa Kullu Nafsin Ma `Amilat Wa Hum La Yuzlamuna
w: and will be paid in full

v.t: And God cites the example of a town that was secure and peaceful, with its livelihood coming to it abundantly from every direction. But then it turned unappreciative of God’s blessings, so God made it taste the robe of hunger and fear, because of what they used to craft
v.l: Wa Đaraba Allahu Mathalaan Qaryatan Kanat 'Aminatan Mutma'innatan Ya'tiha Rizquha Raghadaan Min Kulli Makanin Fakafarat Bi'an`umi Allahi Fa'adhaqaha Allahu Libasa Al-Ju`i Wa Al-Khawfi Bima Kanu Yasna`una

v.t: A messenger from among them had come to them, but they denounced him, so the punishment seized them in the midst of their wrongdoing
v.l: Wa Laqad Ja'ahum Rasulun Minhum Fakadhabuhu Fa'akhadhahumu Al-`Adhabu Wa Hum Zalimuna

v.t: Eat of the lawful and good things God has provided for you, and be thankful for God’s blessings, if it is Him that you serve
v.l: Fakulu Mimma Razaqakumu Allahu Halalaan Tayyibaan Wa Ashkuru Ni`mata Allahi 'In Kuntum 'Iyahu Ta`buduna

v.t: He has forbidden you carrion, and blood, and the flesh of swine, and anything consecrated to other than God. But if anyone is compelled by necessity, without being deliberate or malicious, then God is Forgiving and Merciful
v.l: Innama Harrama `Alaykumu Al-Maytata Wa Ad-Dama Wa Lahma Al-Khinziri Wa Ma 'Uhilla Lighayri Allahi Bihi Famani Ađturra Ghayra Baghin Wa La `Adin Fa'inna Allaha Ghafurun Rahimun

v.t: And do not say of falsehood asserted by your tongues, “This is lawful, and this is unlawful,” in order to invent lies and attribute them to God. Those who invent lies and attribute them to God will not succeed
v.l: Wa La Taqulu Lima Tasifu 'Alsinatukumu Al-Kadhiba Hadha Halalun Wa Hadha Haramun Litaftaru `Ala Allahi Al-Kadhiba 'Inna Al-Ladhina Yaftaruna `Ala Allahi Al-Kadhiba La Yuflihuna

v.t: A brief enjoyment—then they will have a painful punishment
v.l: Mata`un Qalilun Wa Lahum `Adhabun 'Alimun

v.t: For those who are Jews, We have prohibited what We related to you before. We did not wrong them, but they used to wrong their own selves
v.l: Wa `Ala Al-Ladhina Hadu Harramna Ma Qasasna `Alayka Min Qablu Wa Ma Zalamnahum Wa Lakin Kanu 'Anfusahum Yazlimuna

v.t: But towards those who do wrongs in ignorance, and then repent afterwards and reform, your Lord thereafter is Forgiving and Merciful
v.l: Thumma 'Inna Rabbaka Lilladhina `Amilu As-Su'a Bijahalatin Thumma Tabu Min Ba`di Dhalika Wa 'Aslahu 'Inna Rabbaka Min Ba`diha Laghafurun Rahimun

v.t: Abraham was an exemplary leader, devoted to God, a monotheist, and was not of the polytheists
v.l: Inna 'Ibrahima Kana 'Ummatan Qanitaan Lillahi Hanifaan Wa Lam Yaku Mina Al-Mushrikina

v.t: Thankful for His blessings. He chose him, and guided him to a straight path
v.l: Shakiraan Li'n`umihi Ajtabahu Wa Hadahu 'Ila Siratin Mustaqim

v.t: And We gave him goodness in this world, and in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous
v.l: Wa 'Ataynahu Fi Ad-Dunya Hasanatan Wa 'Innahu Fi Al-'Akhirati Lamina As-Salihina

v.t: Then We inspired you: “Follow the religion of Abraham, the Monotheist. He was not an idol-worshiper.”
v.l: Thumma 'Awhayna 'Ilayka 'Ani Attabi` Millata 'Ibrahima Hanifaan Wa Ma Kana Mina Al-Mushrikina

v.t: The Sabbath was decreed only for those who differed about it. Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding their differences
v.l: Innama Ju`ila As-Sabtu `Ala Al-Ladhina Akhtalafu Fihi Wa 'Inna Rabbaka Layahkumu Baynahum Yawma Al-Qiyamati Fima Kanu Fihi Yakhtalifuna

v.t: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good advice, and debate with them in the most dignified manner. Your Lord is aware of those who stray from His path, and He is aware of those who are guided
v.l: Ad`u 'Ila Sabili Rabbika Bil-Hikmati Wa Al-Maw`izati Al-Hasanati Wa Jadilhum Bi-Ati Hiya 'Ahsanu 'Inna Rabbaka Huwa 'A`lamu Biman Đalla `An Sabilihi Wa Huwa 'A`lamu Bil-Muhtadina

v.t: If you were to retaliate, retaliate to the same degree as the injury done to you. But if you resort to patience—it is better for the patient
v.l: Wa 'In `Aqabtum Fa`aqibu Bimithli Ma `Uqibtum Bihi Wa La'in Sabartum Lahuwa Khayrun Lilssabirina

v.t: So be patient. Your patience is solely from God. And do not grieve over them, and do not be stressed by their schemes
v.l: Wa Asbir Wa Ma Sabruka 'Illa Billahi Wa La Tahzan `Alayhim Wa La Taku Fi Đayqin Mimma Yamkuruna

v.t: God is with those who are righteous and those who are virtuous
v.l: Inna Allaha Ma`a Al-Ladhina Attaqaw Wa Al-Ladhina Hum Muhsinuna
